title: Thread hardware encoder runtime evidence into launch preflight
summary: Settings workspace and launch preflight now thread read-only hardware runtime proof evidence from existing encoder capability reports, including verified hardware runtime rows, skipped hardware runtime probes, and active hardware descriptor rows that still lack runtime proof.
reason: The encoder breadth workstream requires launch preflight capability threading and fail-closed hardware evidence before dormant AV1/NVENC, QSV, or AMF families can be enabled. This slice improves operator-facing evidence without changing encoder selection or FFmpeg command generation.
behavior_before: Encoder capability reports could show available/active/inactive encoder counts, but launch preflight did not expose hardware runtime proof gaps directly. Active hardware descriptor rows with skipped runtime probes were only indirectly visible through unavailable/review status.
behavior_after: Read-only Settings and launch preflight evidence include hardware_runtime_verified_encoders, hardware_runtime_skipped_encoders, and active_hardware_runtime_unverified_encoders. Active hardware descriptor rows without runtime proof add review-only error and summary evidence while capability facts continue to exclude unavailable hardware rows.
rollback_plan: Revert the settings_policy.py and preflight_facade.py evidence-threading changes, remove the two focused regression tests, and restore the docs plus generated summaries to the prior encoder-breadth status. This rollback is read-only and does not require source media or runtime state mutation.
